sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Ramesh Kumar Chaurasia
Hon'ble Siddharth,J.
Hon'ble Praveen Kumar Giri,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, Sri Ramesh Kumar Chaurasia, learned counsel for
informant/respondent no.3, learned Aga for the State-respondents and pursed the record.

2.  The writ petition has been filed praying for quashing the First Information Report dated 30.01.2024, registered as Case Crime No.18 of 2024, under Sections-323, 504, 376, IPC and section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Charkhari, District Mahoba, on the basis of compromise dated 13.01.2025.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that on 13.01.2025 the parties have settled their dispute before the court of CJM, Mahoba and order in this regard has been passed by the CJM,
Mahoba.
Certified copy of the order has been brought on record.

It is further submitted that the compromise was arrived at in view of the order 26.11.2024, passed by this Court in Application U/s 528 BNSS No.36647 of 2024(Krishna Kant Yadav Alias Ukendra Vs. State of U.P. and Another).
4.

entities.text: Kant Yadav Alias Ukendra Vs. State of U.P. and Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the respondent no.3, accept that the parties have already arrived at compromise before the court of CJM, Mahoba, as aforesaid, after recording of their statements before the court of CJM, Mahoba.
The respondent no.3 has no objection in case the impugned FIR is quashed by this Court.
5. Learned A.G.A has opposed the prayer for quashing of FIR.

7. The writ petition is allowed.
Order Date :- 7.2.2025 VKG
